messages:
Maya (Product): Quick callout  we need a final cutlist for the public MVP. Two customer-driven asks (quota-based routing + per-tenant billing metrics) are high effort and risky. Proposal: cut quota-routing, keep billing metrics light. Agree?
Dev (Eng): +1 on risk. Quota-routing touches sharding and hot-path routing rules; edge cases will leak into latency. Billing metrics (token/cost totals) are straightforward telemetry.
Sofia (SRE): Ops caution: quota routing could cause cascading rebalances if a tenant hits quota and we try to redirect their traffic. Hard to test at scale before launch. Recommend pilot-only for routing.
Aria (Sales): A couple of large prospects asked for quota controls to enforce spend. They said it's a gating item for procurement. Can we offer a managed pilot with manual enforcement by SEs?
Tom (Design): UX note: if we cut quota routing we must hide quota controls from public Console to avoid confusion. I can design a "Request quota controls" CTA and a minimal billing metrics card.
Maya (Product): Compromise: ship lightweight billing metrics (daily token totals, cost estimates) in MVP; ship quota-based routing as invite-only pilot for Dedicated and Private customers. For prospects wanting quota enforcement now, offer SE-managed manual limits and a pilot onboarding path.
Dev (Eng): Implementation plan: \n- Add a feature-flag gated quota-routing implementation in a feature branch.
- For MVP public branch: remove quota routing hooks, keep telemetry emitters.
Estimate: feature-flag scaffold 2 days, quota engine 5-7 days in feature branch.
Sofia (SRE): Canary/runbook: pilot quota-routing enabled only on isolated Dedicated pools. For any pilot, run 72h with synthetic traffic and monitor p95/queue-latency and autoscaler churn. Revert if p95 delta > 15%.
Aria (Sales): Timeline ask: prospects want quote/contract language that well enable quota controls after pilot. I can get them to sign a pilot MSA if we can promise a 6-week pilot window post-flag.
Tom (Design): I'll prepare the minimal metrics card and the "Request quota pilot" flow; will also hide quota controls in public UI. Drop mocks by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (Product): Action items: \n- Maya: update roadmap & public MVP one-pager to remove quota-routing (EOD).
- Dev: feature-flag branch + PR notes (by Wed).
- Sofia: pilot runbook + alert thresholds (post-PR).
- Tom: UX mocks + hide controls (tomorrow).
- Aria: draft pilot offer language and prospect comms (by Fri).
ci-bot: CI: public-mvp branch tests passed (unit/integration), full e2e scheduled for canary window.
Maya (Product): We'll re-check in Wed sync 09:30 to confirm PR status and pilot leads. If any prospect insists quota is non-negotiable for MVP, escalate to execs for exception review.
Dev (Eng): I'll post the PR link here when ready and include a short perf appendix.
Sofia (SRE): I'll schedule a synthetic load test for the pilot lanes so we have data for the exec review if needed.
Maya (Product): Thanks team  keeping MVP focused while preserving a paid pilot path sounds good. :white_check_mark:
